text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for the Empress, Air Groove, to take on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even prior to her debut, Air Groove's ability and regal air have raised high expectations, and as her trainer, I'm not exempt from the attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First things first, we need to decide a training plan to prepare for the debut race. I go off in search of her, only to find…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The trash can situation on campus is still subpar. That makes two months in a row…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove seems to be in a serious discussion with a group of students.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll bring up trash separation in today's student council meeting. We may need to issue an official notice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems occupied with student council work. Being the council's vice president must be keeping her busy.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeping Committee Member
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I spoke to you about this, Air Groove. Thank you so much for listening.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's part of my student council duties. Please don't hesitate to come to me in the future.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Vice President Air Groove? I've got something I want to discuss with you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It seems my services are needed elsewhere. Thank you for continuing to keep our academy clean.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeping Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Ahh, Air Groove is incredible… She always makes time for us despite being so busy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As impressed as I am by Air Groove's work with the student council, this isn't the time for that!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This poster can be taken down. It'll open up space for something else.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: These club flyers would be best suited elsewhere. Let's move them to the noticeboard in front of the elevator.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I keep trying to find an opportunity to talk to Air Groove, but there seems to be no end to the work she needs to handle.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All right. Please finish up as per my instructions. Let me know how it goes tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Right, next up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I find a gap to get her attention…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Just who I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, President. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want you to look over something before the afternoon meeting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Symboli Rudolf, the president of the Tracen Academy student council, lauded as the strongest among her peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She walks the path of the Emperor with an aura that makes her nigh unapproachable. Many Umamusume look up to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look over there! President Symboli Rudolf is talking to Vice President Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wow, they're even more impressive when you put them next to each other! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whispers bubble through the crowd at Symboli Rudolf's appearance. This has become the worst possible time to interrupt…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's not an urgent matter, but I'd like your input if you've got a moment to spare.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. I just finished up with my other tasks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Then let's head to the student council office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf and Air Groove both walk away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, I was unable to talk to Air Groove. Soon enough, it's time for training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I'll need to cut into training time to discuss things with her. Just as I'm thinking to myself…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you wish to talk to me about something, don't be so craven about it. Come to me directly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unless you were just following me about all day for fun?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. With you constantly scuttling about in the corner of my eye, how could I not?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You were reluctant to talk to me because I seemed busy. Correct?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To be frank, I find that insulting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen. As the Empress, it's my personal policy to remain on top of my student council responsibilities as well as my daily training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you think I can't even make time for a brief discussion, you've severely underestimated my abilities.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you wish to be my trainer, I expect the utmost diligence from you. I don't have time to waste on pleasantries or beating around the bush. Do I make myself clear?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So—what is it you wanted to talk to me about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I finally talk to Air Groove about the training regimen for her upcoming debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Yes, I see what you're going for. Not a bad strategy, I suppose.
choice_data_list: Great! Let's give it our best shot!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Actually, there's something else I'd like to readdress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am the Empress. A guiding beacon who embodies the ideals of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you intend to take the role of my trainer, it is imperative that you understand that people are always watching.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Time's a-ticking. Let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I can process what she's said, Air Groove begins running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove performs the regimen I've given her with aplomb. My breath catches in my throat at the sight of her incredible focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's as tough on herself as she is on others. The sweat on her brow glistens as proof of her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look! Air Groove's running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, the sidelines are packed with onlookers watching Air Groove train.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I can't look away… She's just training, but look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see her debut! I already know she's gonna kill it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's amazing… Keeping her cool even with all these eyes on her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've got to take a leaf out of her book!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I think I can do another few laps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove sets off again, followed by the gazes of the gathered Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their eyes all appear to light up at the sight of her running.
choice_data_list: (This must be what she meant when she said that people are always watching.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I'm to be worthy of standing by her side, I'll need to work extra hard. I make a silent vow to be the best trainer I can be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begin my days challenging the Twinkle Series with Air Groove, the Empress!
